mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products_benefit (sell_products_no, ent_ceo_no, ent_emp_id, benefit_no, benefit_detail, register_date, revision_date, use_status) VALUES (#{sellProductsNo}, #{entCeoNo}, #{entEmpId}, #{benefitNo}, #{benefitDetail}, NOW(), NOW(), #{useStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT products_benefit_no FROM products_benefit ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING(products_benefit_no, 3) AS UNSIGNED) DESC LIMIT 1
